business_problem: CNP Vita Assicura needed to modernize operational, ICT and cyber-risk governance so it could comply with new regulations, reduce manual assessment work, and extend risk and policy controls across the organization through more stable and integrated processes.
solution_summary: CNP Vita Assicura used IBM OpenPages, implemented in SaaS mode with Stratos Analytics, to turn fragmented risk and compliance activity into a structured digital operating model. The program began by re-engineering workflows and logical entities for operational-risk assessment, then configuring OpenPages so data import, workflow execution and go-live could happen within a compressed timeline. After the first module was certified by an independent auditor, the company expanded the platform to corporate governance and policy-compliance use cases, then extended the operational-risk model to additional risk types to build a comprehensive repository. OpenPages' out-of-the-box Policy Compliance Management capabilities gave the team a strong design starting point, and the SaaS deployment shortened setup effort. The result centralizes assessment, monitoring and reporting instead of leaving risk and compliance spread across separate manual activities.

solution_components.name: IBM OpenPages
solution_components.role: Centralizes risk, policy and compliance workflows into an integrated platform for assessment, monitoring and reporting.

data_flow: Risk and policy data is imported into OpenPages, processed through configured assessment workflows, extended into operational and non-operational risk modules, and exposed through monitoring and reporting processes that support governance and compliance teams.
business_outcome: CNP Vita Assicura reduced user data-entry effort, streamlined workflows, improved visibility into assessments and reporting, and created a scalable foundation for broader enterprise risk and compliance management.
